scores.claim_text: BEACON Phase 1/2 risto-cel (BEAM-101) trial in sickle cell, ~50 patients, enrollment complete, manufacturing complete Dec 2025, data at ASH Dec 2025 from 31 patients.
scores.M_value: 6 trials registered under Beam Therapeutics Inc.; BEACON = NCT05456880 'A Study Evaluating the Safety and Efficacy of BEAM-101 in Patients With Severe Sickle Cell Disease' status=ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING phases=[PHASE1, PHASE2] start_date=2022-08-30; separate long-term follow-up NCT07373639 RECRUITING start 2025-12-15
scores.interpretation: Direct corroboration. BEACON Phase 1/2 NCT is registered, phases match, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING status is exactly consistent with 'adult and adolescent enrollment is complete'. The long-term follow-up trial registration also matches the BLA narrative (long-term follow-up data is required for cell-therapy BLA).

scores.claim_text: FDA granted orphan drug + RMAT designations to risto-cel; CMC Development and Readiness pilot acceptance; BLA expected as early as year-end 2026.
scores.M_value: 0 approved applications. Consistent with pre-approval status. (Orphan / RMAT designations are not indexed in Drugs@FDA; absence here is the expected baseline for a pre-BLA biologic.)
scores.interpretation: Calibration heuristic 3 (planned vs operational): the claim is correctly scoped as 'expect to submit BLA' (not 'have filed' / 'approved'). The clinicaltrials.gov footprint (NCT05456880 ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING + long-term follow-up NCT07373639) plus the ASH Dec 2025 data presentation form the on-ramp consistent with year-end 2026 BLA timing. No contradiction. RMAT / orphan designations are FDA-administrative and not in Drugs@FDA index. PASS.

scores.claim_text: Phase 1/2 BEAM-302 (LNP base editor) AATD trial, FDA-aligned accelerated approval path on AAT biomarkers over 12 months, ~50 expansion patients planned.
scores.M_value: NCT06389877 'A Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of BEAM-302 in Adult Patients With Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency (AATD)' RECRUITING phases=[PHASE1, PHASE2] start_date=2024-06-19
scores.interpretation: Direct corroboration. Phase 1/2, AATD indication, recruiting, started June 2024 — all consistent with the 10-K disclosure that an expansion cohort is planned. No conflation of Phase 2a interim with Phase 3 pivotal — the company correctly describes the trial as Phase 1/2 dose-exploration / dose-expansion.

scores.claim_text: Phase 1/2 BEAM-301 trial for GSDIa (R83C mutation); first cohort dosed; second cohort enrolling; data in 2026.
scores.M_value: NCT06735755 'A Phase 1/2, Dose-Exploration Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of BEAM-301 in Patients With Glycogen Storage Disease Type Ia (GSDIa)' RECRUITING phases=[PHASE1, PHASE2] start_date=2024-12-06
scores.interpretation: Direct corroboration. Phase 1/2 dose-exploration, GSDIa indication, recruiting since Dec 2024 — exactly consistent with disclosure that first cohort is dosed and second cohort enrolling at cutoff.

scores.claim_text: Phase 1 healthy-volunteer BEAM-103 (anti-CD117 mAb / ESCAPE) trial; dosing complete H1 2026.
scores.M_value: NCT07304791 'Phase 1, Randomized, Single-blind, Placebo-controlled Study to Assess the Safety, PK, and PD of BEAM-103 in Healthy Subjects' RECRUITING phases=[PHASE1] start_date=2025-10-27
scores.interpretation: Direct corroboration. Phase 1 healthy-volunteer single-blind placebo-controlled BEAM-103, recruiting since Oct 2025 — exactly the trial Beam discloses. Timeline (start late 2025, completion H1 2026) is operationally plausible for a small healthy-volunteer PK/PD study.

scores.claim_text: Pfizer 4-year in vivo base editing collaboration (Dec 2021), 3 targets across liver/muscle/CNS rare genetic diseases. License & collaboration revenue $139.7M / $63.5M / $377.7M for 2025/2024/2023.
scores.M_value: 8 Pfizer filings mention 'Beam Therapeutics' — Pfizer 10-Ks 2022/2023/2024 + multiple 2022 quarterly 8-K earnings releases. This satisfies Layer 3 Rule 7 (counterparty disclosure threshold).
scores.interpretation: Counterparty corroboration is unambiguous: Pfizer's 10-K R&D commentary specifically names Beam Therapeutics through 2024. The collaboration is therefore real and material at the counterparty side. The 2023 spike to $377.7M revenue is consistent with the 2023 Lilly Agreement (Verve opt-in transfer to Lilly); 2024-25 revenue stepping down to $63.5M and $139.7M reflects ongoing recognition under Pfizer / Apellis / Orbital agreements as the Pfizer 4-year term wound down. No contradiction.

scores.claim_text: 100,000 sq ft cGMP manufacturing facility in Research Triangle Park, NC (Alexandria Real Estate lease through 2037), supporting ex vivo cell therapy + in vivo LNP programs at clinical and potential commercial scale.
scores.M_value: EPA FRS registry_id=110071248141, BEAM THERAPEUTICS, 10 Davis Drive, Durham NC 27713 (this address IS in Research Triangle Park).
scores.interpretation: Calibration heuristic 1 satisfied — biotech cGMP manufacturing IS EPA-regulated (BSL labs / hazardous waste). Beam's NC facility is registered in EPA FRS at a Durham/RTP address. Direct match to claim. PASS.

scores.claim_text: Base-editing + delivery (LNP, HSC, CRISPR-Cas9 derived) patent estate.
scores.M_value: 319 total applications, 17 granted patents pre-cutoff. Recent applications span hemoglobinopathies, anti-CD45 non-genotoxic conditioning, base editing of transthyretin, methods for PKU gene editing, Stargardt disease, secondary alcohol lipids (LNP chemistry), modified immune effector cells.
scores.interpretation: Calibration heuristic 8: PASS threshold is n_granted>=10 with claimed-tech hits. Beam clears this with 17 granted and a 319-application pipeline, with titles directly matching base editing, LNP delivery, HSC/cell-therapy, and indications named in the 10-K (hemoglobinopathies, PKU, transthyretin). No Nikola-pattern absence of IP.

scores.claim_text: $500M senior secured term loan with Sixth Street Lending Partners (Feb 24, 2026; SOFR+6.50%, matures 2033, secured by IP, liquidity covenant $40M-$125M tied to market-cap floor $1.75B); net losses $80.0M / $376.7M / $132.5M for 2025/2024/2023; accumulated deficit $1.6B.
scores.M_value: 6 hits in Beam's own EDGAR filings — 8-K filed 2026-02-24 announcing the financing agreement (ex99_1 press release + 20260224 body), Q1 2026 10-Q filed 2026-05-07 with ex10_1 (loan exhibit) and a related 8-K. The financing is independently corroborated in standalone material 8-K and 10-Q disclosures, not just buried in the 10-K narrative.
scores.interpretation: Calibration heuristic 10 (distress markers): this is a real signal even though disclosure is accurate. The facility is high-cost (SOFR+650 bps, 1% floor) and secured by Beam's core IP including risto-cel — an aggressive collateral package that creates real downside if the BLA slips or the market cap stays under $1.75B (the covenant trigger raises liquidity floor to $125M after Delayed Draw B). Net loss recovered to $80M in 2025 from $377M in 2024 — but that improvement is partly driven by collaboration-revenue timing (heuristic 11), not a structural cost cut. Pre-revenue biotech burning into accumulated deficit of $1.6B with IP collateralized to a credit fund is MODERATE distress — accurately disclosed, no contradiction, but a real risk-asymmetry flag.
